target: Specify operational terms and boundaries for tool use using a tool-call plan with observable execution. Meet a declared latency and fail-safe limit under concurrent load.

competency.title: Define tool use — real time
competency.outcome: Specify operational terms and boundaries for tool use using a tool-call plan with observable execution. Meet a declared latency and fail-safe limit under concurrent load.

topic_kernel.artifact: a tool-call plan with observable execution
topic_kernel.failure_to_detect: claiming success without checking the tool result

competency.practice_task: Produce a glossary with a positive and a negative case grounded in a tool-call plan with observable execution.
competency.setting_constraint: Meet a declared latency and fail-safe limit under concurrent load.
required_evidence: a glossary with a positive and a negative case
Include p95 latency, timeout behavior and rollback trace.
Report task completion and invalid-call rate with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: claiming success without checking the tool result.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of tool use.
Practice: the definitions separate valid from invalid cases.
Measurement: report task completion and invalid-call rate against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for claiming success without checking the tool result; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
